overall_vibe: Serene, reverent, and spiritually uplifting. Rooted in South Indian temple aesthetics with a modern, minimalist elegance. Highlights natural textures like sandstone, brass, and the deep black of Krishna shila stone.

color_palette.notes: Colors reflect sandstone (backgrounds), Krishna Shila (text), Saffron (primary actions), and Marigold (secondary/highlights).

headings.usage: Use for all main section titles and hero texts. Embodies the carved-stone and traditional script feel.

body.usage: Clean humanist sans for readable paragraphs, forms, and descriptions.

bilingual.usage: Use as an overline or subtle subtext for English headings to provide Kannada context (e.g., ಶ್ರೀ ಆಂಜನೇಯ ಸ್ವಾಮಿ).

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-24 for sections. Negative space should evoke the quiet vastness of a temple courtyard.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Max-width optimized (max-w-7xl). Align text thoughtfully; center for ceremonial impact, left-align for storytelling and reading.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Soft, 1px subtle borders (border-border). Avoid heavy drop shadows; use soft ambient shadows (shadow-sm, shadow-md) to mimic natural light.

icons.style: Light, elegant strokes. Avoid heavy block icons.

pages.name: Home
sections: Hero: Full bleed subtle background. Centered 'hero_idol_bare' image (with soft rounded edges or arched frame), elegant English heading with Kannada overline. Primary CTA: 'Upcoming Pratishtha Events'.
Introduction: Two-column layout. Brief text on Rampura village and Sri Anjaneya temple. Image: 'sugarcane_field' to represent the Cauvery banks.
Announcement Banner: Full-width muted background. Announcing the new Vidya Hayagreeva shrine.

pages.name: About Rampura
sections: Narrative Layout: Staggered text and image blocks detailing the village's proximity to Mysore/Srirangapatna, agricultural vibrancy, and Cauvery river.

pages.name: The Temple
sections: Anjaneya Shrine: History of the old temple, highlighting the rare Narthaki form.
Vidya Hayagreeva Shrine: Story of the remodeling. Featuring 'idol_adorned_angled' and details about sculptor Adithya Yogiraj.

pages.name: Gallery
sections: Masonry Grid: High-quality display of the 3 idol photos and the traditional lamp. Soft hover zooms.

pages.name: Events & Live Updates
sections: Timeline/Schedule: Prana pratishtha dates, daily aarti timings.
RSVP Form: Custom Shadcn form (Name, Email/Phone, Attendees, Event Select). Styled organically, no SaaS-like blue focus rings. Primary saffron button.

pages.name: Visit
sections: Contact & Location: Embedded Google Maps link (https://maps.app.goo.gl/tWHVdopyxEoxi8ZCA), directions from Mysore, opening hours.

components.name: BilingualHeading
components.description: A reusable component that stacks a small Kannada text (text-primary/70, font-kannada) above a large English heading (font-serif, tracking-tight).
components.usage: Use for section titles across all pages.

components.name: EventCard
components.description: Cardless design, separated by delicate 1px border lines. Contains date box, title, description, and RSVP trigger.

components.name: RegistrationForm
components.description: Utilizes Shadcn Input, Select, and Button. Overridden to use rounded-sm, border-muted, and primary background for the submit button. MUST include data-testid attributes on all inputs and the submit button.

animation_guidelines.scroll: Smooth, gentle fade-ups for text blocks.
animation_guidelines.hover: Subtle light/glow or a simple 2px upward translation for interactive elements.
animation_guidelines.motion: Nothing aggressive. Must feel 'ceremonial' and steady.

critical_rules: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='event-rsvp-button').
Never use generic purple gradients or AI-slop neon.
Ensure contrast ratios comply with accessibility standards, especially when overlaying text on the sandstone backgrounds.
Use standard semantic HTML sections overlaid with Tailwind utility classes.
Images should have max-h constraints (e.g., max-h-[80vh] for hero) to prevent overwhelming mobile viewports.
The Kannada font MUST be loaded and applied correctly where Kannada script is present.
